Command.Statement: with member [Measures].[Colored Profit] as ' [Measures].[Store Sales] - [Measures].[Store Cost] ', FORMAT_STRING = Iif([Measures].[Colored Profit] < 0, "|($#,##0.00)|style=red", "|$#,##0.00|style=green") select {[Measures].[Colored Profit]} on columns, {[Product].Children} on rows from [ZFMSALES]
